remarks: A great fall of Snow but melted as soon as it fell - the Ice on the River began to move -

[facing page p.10] 4th Apr. The Ice on the River was in motion and formed large & high heaps near the Shore & in places in the River where the Water was shallow. In some of these there was an appearance somewhat like a jet d'eau, Pieces of Ice working up in the Centre of the Pyramid or heap - On the 7th & 8 The ice was from time to time in motion, & on the 9th the River was clear of Ice; only some pieces floating down with the Current

doubt: facing page says the River was clear of Ice on the 9th; the table says the 10th

remarks: Rained all day & Wind high from the E
[facing page p.10] The 26th in the morning the Thermometer was broke by accident, which put an end to further observations -
